Load the dataset
```{r}
penguins <- read.csv("penguins.csv")

```

Descriptive Statistics
```{r}
summary(penguins[, c("bill_length_mm", "bill_depth_mm","flipper_length_mm", "body_mass_g")])
```
Species and Sex
```{r}
table(penguins$species, penguins$sex, useNA = "ifany")
```

Run a linear regression: Does flipper length predict body mass?
```{r}
model1 <- lm(body_mass_g ~ flipper_length_mm, data = penguins)
summary(model1)
```
